description: One tree and the answer every reader of 'which project does this directory act on' must give for it. Paths are relative to the scratch base. 'project' is the nearest project store (null: none, refused); 'main' is the main checkout of the repository (null: no repository). Readers: the Node invocation-root door (test/rust-host/invocation-root-table.test.mjs), the Rust host walk (apps/fgos/src/cli_projector.rs tests) and the identity crate's main root (packages/identity/rust/tests/project.rs).
